eyebrow.zh: 钉住的前缀不再被悄悄赶走 · 日志重启不丢 · 空闲会话自动过期 · 长跑也不涨内存
eyebrow.en: Pinned prefixes survive eviction · Logs survive restarts · Idle sessions expire · Long uptime stays bounded

headline.zh:
你以为钉住的前缀还在缓存里
其实早被悄悄赶走又重新计费了——现在它会告诉你，并守住该守住的那一份
headline.en:
The prefixes you pinned were silently evicted and re-billed
— now it tells you, and holds the line on what should stay cached

sub.zh: 一个单二进制，架在你的编码 Agent 和自托管模型服务之间。开启 --pin 后，当某个会话因内存压力被清出去又回来时，它会显式告警（pin_coverage_lost）而不是继续显示一切正常；--ndjson 日志改成追加写入，重启不丢、并发不乱序；再加一个 --idle-ttl，让空闲会话自动过期——长跑部署的内存不再无界增长。
sub.en: A single binary you drop between your coding agent and your self-hosted model server. With --pin on, when a session gets evicted under memory pressure and later returns, it emits an explicit WARN (pin_coverage_lost) instead of reporting all-green; the --ndjson log is opened in append mode so it survives restarts and stays ordered under concurrent writes; and a new --idle-ttl expires idle sessions on their own — long-uptime deployments keep memory bounded.

title.zh: 钉住的前缀被赶走，不再静默失效
title.en: Pinned coverage no longer dies in silence

body.zh: 当内存压力大、某个会话被清出去又回来时，旧版 --pin 只能拿到空的历史，于是放行原样请求、重新计费，而指标面板还显示 100% 保留、0 重处理——你最关心的那条「钉住」保证，恰恰在最该生效时被悄悄绕过。现在工具会记下被清走的会话，下一轮显式打一条告警，并在机器可读日志里标 pin_coverage_lost:true——你一眼就知道该把容量调大。
body.en: When memory pressure evicts a session and it later returns, the old --pin got an empty history and short-circuited — the request went through raw and got re-billed while the dashboard still read 100% preserved, 0 reprocessed. The very guarantee you turned --pin on for was silently bypassed at the moment it mattered most. Now the tool records evicted sessions, emits an explicit WARN on the next turn, and flags pin_coverage_lost:true in the machine-readable log — so you see immediately that it's time to raise the capacity.

title.zh: 重启不丢日志，并发也不乱序
title.en: Logs survive restarts — and stay ordered under load

body.zh: 旧版 --ndjson 每次重启都把先前攒下的面板日志清空；多会话并发时，每条请求抢同一文件位置，内核按拿锁顺序写，可能把第 N+1 轮写到第 N 轮前面——正好砸中你想要多会话隔离的场景。现在日志改成追加写入，重启后先前的轮次还在；并发写入被同一把锁护住，整行落地、按调用顺序排好。
body.en: The old --ndjson wiped the dashboard log you'd asked it to accumulate on every restart; under concurrent multi-session traffic each request raced for the same file offset and the kernel wrote them in lock-grab order — turn N+1 could land ahead of turn N, right in the scenario the multi-session cap is meant for. Now the log is opened in append mode, so prior turns survive a restart; concurrent writes are guarded by one lock and land as whole, in-call-order lines.

title.zh: 长跑部署，内存不再无界增长
title.en: Long uptime, bounded memory — even with no new traffic

body.zh: 会话数上限只在「新会话到来」时才清掉最旧的——一个长期在线、只服务几个偶尔空闲会话的代理，会把它们全钉在内存里永远不清。新增的 --idle-ttl（如 10m、1h）在下一次观察时顺手清掉超时者，不另起后台进程。稀疏、长在线、共享部署的内存就此有界，即便一整晚没有新流量。
body.en: The session-count cap only clears the oldest when a *new* session arrives — a long-lived proxy serving a few sessions that each go idle kept all of them pinned in memory forever. The new --idle-ttl (e.g. 10m, 1h) expires idle ones on the next observation, with no background process. Sparse, long-uptime, shared deployments keep memory bounded — even through a night of zero new traffic.

headline.zh: 钉住该钉住的前缀，并告诉你哪一份丢了
headline.en: Pin the prefixes that should stay — and tell you which ones slipped

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、一个单二进制。架在编码 Agent 和你的模型服务之间，让 KV Cache 不再被悄悄赶走又重新计费。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, a single binary. Sit it between your coding agent and your model server so the KV Cache stops getting silently evicted and re-billed.

tag.zh: 给编码 Agent 的 KV Cache 钉子
tag.en: The pin that keeps your coding agent's KV Cache alive
